Title: Canonical dependency model and compatibility boundary
Purpose: Replace the current dual dependency meaning with one canonical dependency model and quarantine any legacy compatibility behavior behind a single explicit boundary.
Deliverables: A single canonical dependency representation used by core authoring, persistence, clone, read, and runtime paths.
A named compatibility adapter or migration bridge that is the only place allowed to interpret legacy dependency fields if they still temporarily exist.
Removal of scattered fallback logic from helpers and query/runtime code.
Regression coverage proving canonical dependency round-tripping and compatibility behavior.
ReviewQuestions: Is dependency meaning now governed by one canonical representation?
Is any remaining legacy-field interpretation isolated to one named boundary?
Did we remove rather than relocate the fallback duplication?
CorrectiveOnFailure: If canonicality is still ambiguous, stop and use the foundation corrective playbook before any validation/persistence work continues.
